blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Maxene Magalona stood beside her mother, Pia Magalona, during the presentation of a Tribute Award honoring the Filipino music icon, the late Francis Magalona in the Filipino Music Awards 2026 on Tuesday, October 6. She shared the precious moment on social media where she highlighted the importance of choosing peace and embracing life fearlessly. “Mga kababayan, araw-araw piliin ang kapayapaan (To all my fellow Filipinos, every day choose peace),” she wrote, adding, “When you stop fighting with life, life stops fighting with you.” Maxene further reflected on the lessons and legacy of her late father.
